title: LUBRICATION
summary: Lubrication chart, sheet 3: codes 11a-11g (9981117 lubricant: door lock strikers, door weatherstrip, guide pin holes, C07 hardtop weatherstrip/headliner), 12a-12m (3832534 grease: brake pedal, clutch pedal/fork/release bearing linkage, upper hinge spring rollers, M20 reverse interlock cable), 13a (3834716 Teflon grease, turn-signal cancel cam) and 14a (9985006 refrigerant oil, A/C compressor O-ring).
notes_internal: Table: PART column filled down to every code row of its block (printed once per block). Multi-line cells joined with single spaces; syllable hyphens at line breaks removed (e.g. 'CHAN-NELS' -> 'CHANNELS'), real dashes kept. Diamond symbol after each code omitted.
11e has two stacked UPC/SUB-GRP pairs printed on separate lines: '1' over 'C07' and 'F' over 'A'; written here as '1 / C07' and 'F / A' (slash not printed).
12f UPC: top of the character is inside a binder hole; only a lower stroke (looks like the foot of a 7) is visible. Left as '?'.
12f-12m sit in the right column with no PART text; treated as continuing 3832534 GREASE.
Revision date: middle digit after '6-1' unreadable (6-15/6-16?).
'GROVE' (sic) copied as printed. C/O box reads 'D3 & D4'.
